name: The Fool
message: A fresh start is possible when you let curiosity lead.

name: The Magician
message: You may already have more tools and abilities than you realize.

name: The High Priestess
message: Make room for quiet reflection and listen to what matters to you.

name: The Empress
message: Let care, creativity, and comfort have a place in your life.

name: The Emperor
message: Clear boundaries and steady plans can support what you want to build.

name: The Hierophant
message: There may be value in a mentor, a lesson, or a tradition you choose.

name: The Lovers
message: Choose in a way that reflects your values and nurtures meaningful connection.

name: The Chariot
message: Progress can come from choosing a direction and staying intentional.

name: Strength
message: Gentle courage can be just as powerful as force.

name: The Hermit
message: A little quiet time may help you hear your own thoughts.

name: Wheel of Fortune
message: Change is part of life; stay flexible as a new cycle unfolds.

name: Justice
message: Aim for honesty, fairness, and choices you can stand behind.

name: The Hanged Man
message: A pause may help you see a familiar situation differently.

name: Death
message: An ending can mark a transition and make room for something new.

name: Temperance
message: Small, balanced adjustments may serve you better than extremes.

name: The Devil
message: Notice habits or expectations that may be limiting your freedom.

name: The Tower
message: When something changes unexpectedly, focus on what can be rebuilt honestly.

name: The Star
message: Give yourself permission to hope and recover your sense of possibility.

name: The Moon
message: When things feel unclear, move slowly and separate feelings from facts.

name: The Sun
message: Make space for simple joys and the people who help you feel alive.

name: Judgement
message: Reflect on what you have learned and decide what you want to carry forward.

name: The World
message: Recognize how far you have come and welcome the next chapter.
